# Notable

> Brand, platform, and revenue buildout for high-performing women founders and executives. Notable builds the qualifications packages, decks, and websites that get a founder in the room — and the platform that makes the expertise she already had known, monetized, and notable. A brand of DakJen Creative LLC.

Notable works with women solopreneurs, small business owners, and executives who have built real businesses, real impact, and real expertise, but whose brand does not yet reflect the caliber of their work. The core promise is getting a founder out of best-kept-secret status.

Notable executes rather than advises: every engagement ends with finished assets in hand, not a strategy deck.

## Services

- [Notable Essentials](https://gobenotable.com/essentials): Brand foundation collateral, priced by the piece. One-pager or sell sheet $350. Executive bio or resume $350. Service promo or brochure $450 (includes 50 printed copies). Line card or service menu $450. Company profile $650. Branded proposal/SOW template $700. Brand style mini-guide $750. Branded deck template $600. Pitch or investor presentation $1,400. Capabilities/qualifications package $2,000. Project profiles and case studies quoted custom. All prices are starting points. Two rounds of revisions included. Turnaround 1–2 weeks for a single item, 2–4 weeks for larger scopes. Payment 35% deposit, 65% on delivery.
- [Standalone intensives](https://gobenotable.com/essentials): LinkedIn Voice Intensive from $1,500. Video Content Intensive from $2,000. Social Media Handbook & 30-Day Plan from $2,750. Each can be purchased on its own or added to any Essentials engagement.
- [Notable Amplify](https://gobenotable.com/amplify): Flagship tier. Platform and revenue stream buildout — online courses, book proposals, LinkedIn presence, blogs and newsletters, fireside chat or speaking series, new lines of business. Custom-scoped, from $4,000, over a 6–8 week timeline. Most engagements include 2–4 deliverables.
- Amplify+ Ongoing: Monthly platform management retainer, $3,000–$5,000 per month, three-month minimum.
- [The 24-Hour Brand Intensive](https://gobenotable.com/intensive): Fixed-scope, high-output engagement. One-hour kickoff, then 24 hours of build. Tier 1 "The Launch" $1,750 — website (1–4 pages), 2–4 branded templates, 30 days of LinkedIn content. Tier 2 "The Foundation" $4,500 — everything in The Launch plus 3 brand deliverables and a 90-day marketing plan. Limited to two per month. 50% deposit reserves the date.
- [Notable Vanguard](https://gobenotable.com/vanguard): An application-only sibling program for men of color operating at the top of their craft. Not open enrollment; every application is reviewed personally.

## Proof

- [Client results](https://gobenotable.com/results): A five-year engagement with a real estate developer, affordable housing leader, and speaker produced 237% LinkedIn network growth, a 28× increase in engagement, 336 posts published, and 3,898 connections added — including 535+ director-level, 510+ president or principal, 504+ founder, and 338+ CEO contacts. Published anonymized.

## Who Notable is for

- Founders winning work but losing bids to firms with better materials
- Founders who have the credentials and none of the collateral
- Founders who want assets in hand, not a strategy deck
- Women of color founders pursuing contracts, investment, and partnerships
- Executives building a personal brand and thought leadership platform

## Who Notable is not for

- Anyone who wants a logo and nothing else
- Pre-revenue founders testing an idea
- Anyone who wants advice rather than execution
